Junior Frontend Developer - Remote (LATAM)

About the role
We are looking for a junior developer to join our product team. You will build features with React and TypeScript.

Requirements
- 1+ years of experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
- Solid knowledge of React, HTML and CSS
- Experience consuming REST APIs
- Git and GitHub
- Good English communication skills

Nice to have
- Next.js
- Tailwind CSS
- Unit testing with Jest
- Figma

Benefits
- Fully remote, flexible hours
